A quicker way to see how this works than another email: the interactive walkthrough follows a refund through an illustrative Qlaas service.

The refund case
  Within policy: Receive · Verify · Authorise · Execute · Reconcile · Complete
  Exception: Delegated limit exceeded, so the case waits for human authorisation
  Closes when: Provider and ledger agree, and the customer is notified

It takes a couple of minutes, and the same pattern applies to routine supply administration at {{company}}.
